name: Bread and Butter Pudding
assumptions: Yield estimated from typical bread-and-butter-pudding recipes using 8 slices bread and 500 ml dairy; standard 6 servings.
Total time aggregates active prep (~20 min), 30 min standing, and 30-40 min bake (using 35 min midpoint) plus oven preheat (~5 min).
Butter classified as dairy and potential milk allergen source.
Bread assumed wheat-based white bread (common for this recipe); crusts removed but still contains gluten.
Sultanas, cinnamon, sugar, and nutmeg introduce no listed allergens or diet conflicts.
Milk, double cream, and eggs are explicitly dairy and egg ingredients; used in custard.
No fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, soy, or sesame appear in ingredients or instructions.
instructions:
Grease a 1 litre/2 pint pie dish with butter.
Cut the crusts off the bread. Spread each slice with on one side with butter, then cut into triangles.
Arrange a layer of bread, buttered-side up, in the bottom of the dish, then add a layer of sultanas. Sprinkle with a little cinnamon, then repeat the layers of bread and sultanas, sprinkling with cinnamon, until you have used up all of the bread. Finish with a layer of bread, then set aside.
Gently warm the milk and cream in a pan over a low heat to scalding point. Don't let it boil.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, add three quarters of the sugar and lightly whisk until pale.
Add the warm milk and cream mixture and stir well, then strain the custard into a bowl.
Pour the custard over the prepared bread layers and sprinkle with nutmeg and the remaining sugar and leave to stand for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 180C/355F/Gas 4.
Place the dish into the oven and bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the custard has set and the top is golden-brown.

ingredients.name: butter
ingredients.assumptions: Standard unsalted butter; entire 25 g quantity used to grease dish and spread on bread.

ingredients.name: bread
ingredients.assumptions: 8 thin slices white bread (approx 25 g per slice including crusts); crusts removed but weight is for whole slices before trimming as is typical in such estimates.

ingredients.name: sultanas
ingredients.assumptions: Standard sultanas (golden raisins); entire listed quantity used across layers.

ingredients.name: cinnamon
ingredients.assumptions: 2 tsp ground cinnamon (≈5 g total); used for sprinkling between layers.

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.assumptions: Whole cow's milk; entire 350 ml volume (density ≈1.03 g/ml) gently warmed and used in custard.

ingredients.name: double cream
ingredients.assumptions: Standard double (heavy) cream; entire 50 ml volume (density ≈1 g/ml) warmed with milk.

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.assumptions: 2 large free-range eggs (≈50 g each edible portion); cracked and whisked into custard base.

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.assumptions: White granulated sugar; 25 g total split between whisking into eggs and sprinkling on top.

ingredients.name: nutmeg
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh grated nutmeg to taste (small plausible amount for sprinkling); negligible weight and nutrients in context of whole recipe.
